storyTeaser.headline:
Not a dessert.
Not a cocktail.
Just a damn good candle.
storyTeaser.body: 55° candles brings together natural plant wax, fine fragrances and a little handmade magic in one simple tin. Made with care, served with mood, and ready to turn an ordinary day into something a little more special.
storyTeaser.imageAlt: An Espresso Martini candle beside a takeaway coffee and a laptop on a walnut chair, with a tweed coat draped over its back

testimonials.title: What people say about us
testimonials.1text: It looks like a real cherry, it smells even better and yes — my first thought was to eat it.
testimonials.2text: I bought four as gifts. Everyone was delighted, and in the end I ordered one for myself too.
testimonials.3text: I loved the Espresso Martini. It smells really good and looks great at home.

candleCareSection.title: Candle care
candleCareSection.tip1Body: Take it down to about 5 mm before every burn — it keeps the flame steady and soot-free.
candleCareSection.tip2Body: Let it burn until the wax pool reaches the edge of the tin. It saves the candle from tunnelling for good.
candleCareSection.tip3Body: Longer than that overheats the tin and burns through the fragrance faster.
candleCareSection.tip4Body: And out of reach of children and pets. Never leave a burning candle unattended.

cherry.description: A warm, playful cherry scent — rich and juicy, like late summer. Finished with a sculpted cherry detail that feels almost too perfect to light.

orange.description: Clean, bright citrus with a soft floral edge. Uplifting and effortless — like sunlight through an open window.

vanilla.description: Warm, smooth, and quietly indulgent. A comforting vanilla that settles into the space without ever overwhelming it.

strawberry.description: Bright and juicy with a soft sweetness. Fresh-picked and vibrant, with a playful finish that lifts any space.

espresso-martini.description: Rich espresso layered with soft vanilla and amber. Bold, smooth, and quietly indulgent — made for slower evenings.

winter-wonderland.description: A winter blend of pine, spice, and soft vanilla. Cool, comforting, and only here for a short time.

ourStory.title: Our story
ourStory.intro: 55° candles was born from a simple idea: candles should be honest, beautiful, and safe for your home.
ourStory.edibleBody: No. We know it looks like it. The fruit is wax, made by hand down to the last detail so that it looks almost real. Real enough that “is this edible?” is a perfectly fair question.
ourStory.value1Body: Soy wax and a cotton wick. That's it. No paraffin, no lead, nothing you don't need.
ourStory.value2Body: Our fragrance oils are phthalate-free. Nothing complicated — just what we want in our own candles.
ourStory.value3Body: Nothing hidden. Everything is written down, as it should be.

candleCarePage.title: Candle care
candleCarePage.subtitle: Simple steps to make your 55° candles last longer and burn better.
candleCarePage.firstBurnBody: Always burn your candle until the wax melts fully to the edges of the can — this usually takes 2 to 3 hours. Skipping this step can cause tunnelling, where wax builds up around the wick and reduces your candle's life.
candleCarePage.wickBody: Trim the wick to 5mm before every burn. A long wick creates a larger, sootier flame. A quick trim keeps the burn clean and even.
candleCarePage.burnTimeBody: Keep burns to 3 hours maximum. After 3 hours the can gets hot enough to affect the wax quality. Give your candle a rest — it'll reward you with a longer life.
candleCarePage.storageBody: Keep the lid on when not burning. Store away from direct sunlight and in a cool room. Wax can soften in heat, which may shift the wax fruit decoration.

terms.title: Terms and Conditions
terms.summary: The rules that apply when you buy from 55° candles, who you are contracting with, and what you can expect from us.

sections.heading: 1. Who we are
sections.body: This website is operated by ВиреонЛабс ЕООД (VireonLabs EOOD), ЕИК 208907603, trading as 55° candles. Our full identification and contact details are set out below and in the footer of every page.

sections.heading: 2. Scope
sections.body: These Terms apply to every order placed through this website. By placing an order you confirm you have read and accepted them. They form part of the contract between you and us, alongside the Privacy Policy, the Cookie Policy, the Right of Withdrawal and the Delivery Information.

sections.heading: 3. Products
sections.body: We sell decorative scented candles with hand-sculpted wax fruit. The wax fruit is decorative and is not food. Product photographs are representative; because each candle is finished by hand, small variations in colour and shape are normal and are not a defect.

sections.heading: 4. Prices
sections.body: [TODO: state the currency, whether prices include VAT, and the VAT rate.] All prices are shown per item and exclude delivery charges unless stated otherwise. Delivery charges are shown before you confirm your order.

sections.heading: 5. How a contract is formed
sections.body: Adding items to your basket and reaching the checkout is not an order. A contract is formed only when you confirm your order and we send you a written order confirmation to the email address you gave us. Until then no contract exists and you owe us nothing.

sections.heading: 6. Payment
sections.body: Payment is by cash on delivery (наложен платеж) only: you pay the courier in cash when the parcel is handed to you. We accept no card payments, so no card details are ever entered on this website. [TODO: state the cash-on-delivery fee, if any, and whether the customer or we pay it.]

sections.heading: 7. Delivery
sections.body: Delivery areas, carriers, timescales and charges are set out in our Delivery Information, which forms part of these Terms.

sections.heading: 8. Your right to withdraw
sections.body: If you are a consumer you may withdraw from the contract within 14 days without giving a reason. How to do this, and the standard withdrawal form, are set out in our Right of Withdrawal and Returns page.

sections.heading: 9. Faulty or non-conforming goods
sections.body: You have a statutory right to goods that conform to the contract. If they do not, you may claim a repair, a replacement, a price reduction or a refund, in the order and on the conditions set by Bulgarian consumer law. This right lasts two years from delivery and is separate from, and additional to, your right of withdrawal. See our Complaints page.

sections.heading: 10. Safe use
sections.body: Candles are an open flame. Never leave a burning candle unattended, keep it away from children, pets and anything flammable, and follow the instructions on the product and on our Candle Care page.

sections.heading: 11. Your personal data
sections.body: We process your personal data as described in our Privacy Policy. Placing an order requires us to process your name, contact details and delivery address in order to perform the contract.

sections.heading: 12. Complaints and dispute resolution
sections.body: Please contact us first — most issues are resolved quickly. You may also complain to the Commission for Consumer Protection (Комисия за защита на потребителите, kzp.bg) and, for out-of-court settlement, to the relevant conciliation commission or the EU online dispute resolution platform.

sections.heading: 13. Applicable law
sections.body: These Terms are governed by Bulgarian law. Nothing in them limits the rights you have as a consumer under mandatory Bulgarian or EU law. If any provision is unenforceable, the rest continues to apply.

sections.heading: 14. Changes
sections.body: We may update these Terms. The version that applies to your order is the one published when you placed it, and we keep the date of the last change at the top of this page.

If you place an order we record the recipient name, telephone number, email address, delivery address or collection point, and what you ordered, because we cannot deliver a parcel without them. cookies.title: Cookie Policy
cookies.summary: What we store on your device. Today: almost nothing.

sections.heading: 1. What cookies are
sections.body: Cookies and similar technologies are small files a site stores on your device, for example to remember a preference or to keep you logged in.

sections.heading: 2. What we use right now
sections.body: This site currently sets no analytics, advertising or tracking cookies. It loads no Google Analytics, no tag manager, no Meta pixel and no third-party tracker. Our fonts are served from our own domain, so no request is made to Google when you visit.

sections.heading: 3. Strictly necessary storage
sections.body: Your chosen language is part of the web address (/en or /bg) rather than a cookie. Once a shopping basket exists, keeping it between pages will require strictly necessary storage, which does not need your consent because the shop cannot work without it.

sections.heading: 4. Consent
sections.body: If we ever add analytics or marketing technologies, we will ask for your consent first, by category, with refusing as easy as accepting, and you will be able to change your mind at any time from this page. We will not set any non-essential cookie before you agree.

sections.heading: 5. Controlling cookies
sections.body: You can delete or block cookies in your browser settings. Blocking strictly necessary storage may stop parts of the shop working.

returns.title: Right of Withdrawal and Returns
returns.summary: As a consumer you can change your mind within 14 days. Here is how.

sections.heading: 1. Your right to withdraw
sections.body: If you are a consumer you may withdraw from the contract within 14 days without giving any reason and without penalty. The period runs from the day you, or someone you nominated, take physical possession of the goods — for an order delivered in several parts, from the last part.

sections.heading: 2. How to withdraw
sections.body: Tell us clearly, before the 14 days are up, that you are withdrawing. Email or write to us using the details below — you may use the form in section 6, but you do not have to. Sending the goods back with a clear note also counts. Simply refusing delivery is not a reliable way to withdraw, so please tell us as well.

sections.heading: 3. Sending the goods back
sections.body: Send the goods back without undue delay and within 14 days of telling us you withdraw. [TODO: state who pays the cost of return — you may require the consumer to bear it, but only if this page says so before they order. If it does not, you must pay it.]

sections.heading: 4. Refunds
sections.body: We refund all payments we received from you, including the standard delivery charge, within 14 days of your withdrawal. We may wait until we have the goods back, or proof that you sent them. We refund using the same means of payment you used, unless you agree otherwise, and it costs you nothing. If you chose a more expensive delivery option than our cheapest standard one, we refund only the standard amount.

sections.heading: 5. Condition of the goods, and exceptions
sections.body: You may examine the goods as you would in a shop, but you are liable for any reduction in value caused by handling beyond that. A candle that has been burned cannot normally be returned under this right. [TODO: confirm with a lawyer whether any statutory exception applies to your products — for example sealed goods unsuitable for return on hygiene grounds, or goods made to the consumer's specification.]

sections.heading: 6. Standard withdrawal form
sections.body: To ВиреонЛабс ЕООД: I hereby give notice that I withdraw from my contract of sale of the following goods — [describe the goods]. Ordered on [date] / received on [date]. Name of consumer: [name]. Address of consumer: [address]. Signature (only if sent on paper): [signature]. Date: [date].

sections.heading: 7. This is not your only right
sections.body: The right of withdrawal is separate from your statutory rights if the goods are faulty or do not match their description. Those last two years — see our Complaints page.

complaints.title: Complaints and Faulty Goods
complaints.summary: What to do if something arrives damaged, faulty, or not as described.

sections.heading: 1. Your statutory rights
sections.body: Goods must match their description and be of satisfactory quality. If they do not conform to the contract you have a claim for two years from delivery, at no cost to you. This is a legal right and is in addition to your 14-day right of withdrawal.

sections.heading: 2. What you can ask for
sections.body: First, a repair or a replacement, whichever you prefer, unless it is impossible or disproportionate. If that is not carried out within a reasonable time and without significant inconvenience to you, you may then ask for a price reduction or cancel the contract and get your money back.

sections.heading: 3. How to make a claim
sections.body: Contact us using the details below with your order number, what is wrong, and photographs if the item arrived damaged. Please keep the packaging until the claim is settled, as the courier may need to inspect it.

sections.heading: 4. Our response
sections.body: [TODO: confirm the response time you commit to.] We will acknowledge your claim in writing, tell you whether we accept it, and if we do, how and by when we will resolve it. We keep a register of claims as required by Bulgarian consumer law.

sections.heading: 5. Damage in transit
sections.body: Please check your parcel on delivery. If it is visibly damaged, note this with the courier before signing, and tell us the same day. This makes a claim against the carrier far easier, though it does not affect your rights against us.

sections.heading: 6. If we cannot agree
sections.body: You may refer the matter to the Commission for Consumer Protection (Комисия за защита на потребителите, kzp.bg), to the relevant conciliation commission for an out-of-court settlement, or to the EU online dispute resolution platform.
